use_rule: Recheck applicable official docs and actual account/export capabilities during each audit. Dates describe this review, not perpetual freshness. Preserve conflicting claims until a current authoritative source or account evidence clarifies them.

entries.guidance: Crawl access, successful response and indexable content establish eligibility; indexing is not guaranteed. Robots blocking does not establish removal from search.

entries.scope: AI Overviews and AI Mode; property report availability must be checked
entries.status: Sources differ on report/eligibility wording; do not assume a dedicated report exists or is required
entries.guidance: Foundational SEO and useful content remain relevant. Do not prescribe special AI schema/files as prerequisites. Standard Web reporting cannot by itself isolate AI visibility. Use documented feature fields only when present in the actual property/export.
Anonymized queries and data limits can omit rows; explain gaps between exported query and property totals.
CrUX uses a sliding 28-day window; preserve percentile, device and URL/origin scope. Lab scores are not field Core Web Vitals.
Authenticated short-window behavior exports require timestamps, documented API limits and privacy handling; verify limits before collection.
Check current feature eligibility before recommending markup; detected JSON-LD is not proof of valid rich-result eligibility.
Verify applicable eligibility, address and representation rules before recommending changes.
